items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: And that brings to mind another 17-year-old, Ernie Andrews. I did his first record date, a thing called "Soothe Me."

ctx.x: Was it Billy Eckstine's band? Either Billy Eckstine or Earl Hines; I'm not sure which. Anyhow, she was very young, too. And how I met her was, one day she was living in a hotel on Olympic and San Pedro -- I don't remember the name. Anyhow, she was trying to get out there, and I offered to take her. So that's my first meeting with Sarah Vaughan. She was 17 then, too.
And that brings to mind another 17-year-old, Ernie Andrews. I did his first record date, a thing called "Soothe Me."
Oh, I remember that. Was that for Gene Norman?
